name: Prairie Wolf Paw
summary: Across Mulgore, Prairie Wolf Paws are gathered from the wolves that hunt the plains. Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village uses them with plainstrider talons to make a cleansing totem.

sections.title: Natural Reagents of the Plains
sections.body: Prairie wolves hunt in packs across Mulgore’s rolling grasses, alongside prairie stalkers and their pack alphas. They threaten young hunters and local livestock, and their place in the spiritual balance of the plains matters to tauren shamans. The shamans see the paws as more than trophies: they carry the land’s innate vitality.

sections.title: Cleansing the Wells
sections.body: When goblin ventures tainted Mulgore’s sacred water reserves, shaman Mull Thunderhorn needed the land’s physical aid against the pollution. Joined with plainstrider talons, wolf paws provide the spiritual resonance for cleansing totems. With one made, the work of purifying the Winterhoof Water Well can begin.

faq.q: What creatures drop a Prairie Wolf Paw?
aliases: where to get prairie wolf paws
faq.answer: Prairie wolves, prairie stalkers, and prairie wolf alphas hunt across Mulgore’s plains, primarily southwest of Bloodhoof Village, and provide Prairie Wolf Paws.
Mull Thunderhorn, a tauren shaman in Bloodhoof Village, wants them to help make a cleansing totem for the tainted water wells.

faq.q: Why are wolf paws needed to cleanse water?
faq.answer: Tauren shamans channel the land’s natural vitality against corruption. Joined with bird talons, wolf paws help bind Mulgore’s living spirit into an elemental totem that can purge goblin poisons.

faq.q: Which water well do these paws help cleanse?
faq.answer: The paws help make a cleansing totem for the Winterhoof Water Well, poisoned by goblin interlopers and their agents.

angles.text: For tauren, harvesting wolf paws is a solemn duty of stewardship: the land’s native beasts help heal ancestral water wells tainted by goblin greed.
Cleansing totems made from local animal parts draw on the land’s living essence to purge unnatural corruption.
